definition: the place where two streets meet
description: A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.
